# shadcn/ui · Atlas gallery reference

Original: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui
Revision: `25af02b1b467fcd53b63e0c6d6d324c57c16ef18`
License: MIT — see LICENSE.md.

The enclosed upstream `block-viewer.tsx`, `block-display.tsx` and `site-header.tsx` are retained as references. Atlas adapts their horizontal site navigation, neutral styling, compact viewer toolbar, device toggles, full-width live iframe and code/preview workflow to this static JavaScript archive. The upstream React/Next.js components are not loaded at runtime; this adaptation preserves the current static hosting architecture.

本站画廊按官方 Blocks 的顶部导航、精简预览工具栏、设备切换和大幅原生 iframe 结构适配。原始 React/Next.js 文件保存在本目录溯源，运行时使用适合 GitHub Pages 的静态实现。图标采用 Lucide，字体采用 Inter，分别保留许可。
